column1: # clues.tsv for ft_str_is_alpha — hints only, never answers.
What counts as a letter, and why should an EMPTY string return 1 (are all zero of its characters letters)?

Watch the edges of your letter ranges: '@' sits just before 'A', '[' just after 'Z', '`' just before 'a', '{' just after 'z'. If any of these is wrongly accepted as a letter, a range bound is off by one.
